# 🧭 qa-core

Test design, planning, exploratory testing, requirements traceability and bug reporting.

Install: `qa-core@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

📘 **Guide:** [Beyond Codegen 2.0](guides/beyond-codegen.md) shows how the pieces work together.

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`create-test-plan`](skills/create-test-plan/SKILL.md): Generate a comprehensive test plan
- [`test-plan-basic`](skills/test-plan-basic/SKILL.md): Generate a basic test plan
- [`qa-strategy`](skills/qa-strategy/SKILL.md): QA strategy - edge cases, security and attack scenarios
- [`review-requirements`](skills/review-requirements/SKILL.md): Review requirements for testability
- [`regression-scope`](skills/regression-scope/SKILL.md): Analyze regression scope
- [`manual-test-cases`](skills/manual-test-cases/SKILL.md): Generate manual test cases
- [`derive-test-cases-from-code`](skills/derive-test-cases-from-code/SKILL.md): Derive test cases from code
- [`generate-gherkin-scenarios`](skills/generate-gherkin-scenarios/SKILL.md): Generate Gherkin scenarios
- [`generate-exploratory-charters`](skills/generate-exploratory-charters/SKILL.md): Generate exploratory testing charters
- [`generate-test-data`](skills/generate-test-data/SKILL.md): Generate test data
- [`map-requirements-coverage`](skills/map-requirements-coverage/SKILL.md): Map requirements to test coverage
- [`verify-acceptance-criteria`](skills/verify-acceptance-criteria/SKILL.md): Verify acceptance criteria
- [`bug-report`](skills/bug-report/SKILL.md): Create a bug report
- [`explain-code`](skills/explain-code/SKILL.md): Analyze and explain code
- [`edge-case-scenario-generator`](skills/edge-case-scenario-generator/SKILL.md): Edge Case Scenario Generator (BDD)

| QA Strategist - Edge Cases, Security & Attacks | [`qa-strategist`](agents/qa-strategist.md) | [`qa-strategist`](.github/agents/qa-strategist.agent.md) | [`qa_strategist`](codex/agents/qa-strategist.toml) |
| Test Planner | [`test-planner`](agents/test-planner.md) | [`test-planner`](.github/agents/test-planner.agent.md) | [`test_planner`](codex/agents/test-planner.toml) |
| Rubber Duck - Socratic debugging partner | [`rubber-duck`](agents/rubber-duck.md) | [`rubber-duck`](.github/agents/rubber-duck.agent.md) | [`rubber_duck`](codex/agents/rubber-duck.toml) |
| AI Test Architect: Beyond Codegen 2.0 | [`ai-architect`](agents/ai-architect.md) | [`ai-architect`](.github/agents/ai-architect.agent.md) | [`ai_architect`](codex/agents/ai-architect.toml) |

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.

## MCP servers

- `playwright`: `npx @playwright/mcp@latest`

Claude Code and Codex start these from the plugin. In GitHub Copilot, add them to your MCP configuration yourself.
